key_insight: Short-wave instabilities in helical vortices saturate weakly at low linear growth rates but substantially deform the vortex and unstable modes at higher growth rates.
engineering_relevance: These dynamics could inform wind-turbine tip-vortex control strategies aimed at accelerating wake recovery and improving turbine performance.
method: Direct numerical simulations of helical vortices with axial flow.
Vary normalized core radius and reduced pitch for elliptic and curvature instabilities.
Compare nonlinear evolution with weakly nonlinear analysis.
evidence_signal: The parameter sweep reveals two nonlinear regimes, with higher-growth cases reaching larger disturbance energies and exciting nonlinear effects and modal components omitted from weakly nonlinear analysis.
watch_item: The study uses idealized helical vortices; effectiveness in realistic turbine wakes remains to be demonstrated.
paper_title: Nonlinear dynamics of short-wave instabilities in a helical vortex within and beyond the weakly nonlinear regime
